author: Ryan Daws
description:
Software developers assessing deployment risks can now evaluate consolidated development telemetry through the Release Readiness Index, a capability introduced by PractiTest to guide quality decisions across engineering pipelines. Built as an analytical layer within the vendor’s wider QA Intelligence initiative, the system links test execution, requirements coverage, and outstanding defects into a single evaluative score. […]

The post PractiTest turns software QA data into a release readiness score appeared first on Developer Tech News.
title: PractiTest turns software QA data into a release readiness score
